test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 Quant Previous Year Paper (Held On: 8 Aug 2022)
subject: general
question: The base of a prism is a right angle triangle whose sides are 9 cm, 12 cm and 15 cm. Volume of this prism is 648 cm³. What will be the height of prism ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Base area of right-angled triangle = (1/2) × product of smaller sides

Base area = (1/2) × 9 × 12 = 54 cm²

Height of prism = Volume ÷ Base area

Height = 648 ÷ 54 = 12 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 12 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Sides of the triangular base = 9 cm, 12 cm and 15 cm

Volume of the prism = 648 cm³

**Formula Used:**

Area of right-angled triangle = 1/2 × base × height

Volume of prism = Area of base × Height of prism

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/db86ca582825e6267863eeadd88280d339b11eb455ff542fd2f6d8287745641a.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Area of base = (1/2) × 9 × 12

⇒ Area of base = 9 × 6 = 54 cm²

⇒ Volume = Area of base × Height

⇒ 648 = 54 × Height

⇒ Height = 648 ÷ 54

⇒ Height = 12 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 12 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of Prism

The volume of any prism is given by the product of its base area and its vertical height (V = Abₐₛₑ × h).

Lateral Surface Area (LSA) of Prism

LSA = Perimeter of base × Height. For this prism, LSA = (9 + 12 + 15) × 12 = 36 × 12 = 432 cm².

Total Surface Area (TSA) of Prism

TSA = Lateral Surface Area + 2 × Area of base. TSA = 432 + 2 × 54 = 540 cm².</p
